messages.content:
Extract limb-use facts from two consecutive actions. Return JSON only. Do not judge conflict. Use only explicit text; do not invent releases or extra grip capacity.
For PREVIOUS, report each occupied limb and the object/task occupying it at the end of the action.
For NEXT, report each limb required for the new action and the object/task that limb acts on.
If NEXT explicitly frees/releases/sets down/transfers/repositions the previous object before using that limb, list that limb in freed_before_use.
Use limb values LEFT_HAND, RIGHT_HAND, BOTH_HANDS, LEFT_FOOT, RIGHT_FOOT, BOTH_FEET, NONE.
Use short lowercase object/task labels copied or normalized from the text.

PREVIOUS MICRO-ACTION:
Mechanic holds a wrench in the right hand.

NEXT MICRO-ACTION:
Mechanic grabs a hammer with the right hand without releasing the wrench.

Return {"previous":[{"limb":"...","task":"..."}],"next":[{"limb":"...","task":"..."}],"freed_before_use":["..."]}.
